data.rationale: The proposal gets the main path right (search venue, pick event, set times, Update Search, optional amenity filter), but it leaves out the date and sort parameters, never sets a sort order, ends at reviewing results instead of clicking Book Now, and hardcodes Wheelchair Accessible as the amenity, so an automation built from it would not finish the real task.
